The minimum number of spheres to be generated

If disabled, allow very small VDBs to not generate any spheres.

NOTE:

    Spheres smaller than __Min Radius__ might be generated
    in order to ensure that the minimum sphere count is satisfied.

spheresmin.name: spheresmin
spheresmin.label: Min Spheres
tags_tokens:
The minimum number of spheres to be generated

If disabled, allow very small VDBs to not generate any spheres.

NOTE:
    __Min Spheres__ takes precedence over __Min Radius__.
    Spheres smaller than __Min Radius__ might be generated
    in order to ensure that the minimum sphere count is satisfied.
